name: Bug Off B*tch Natural Bug Spray
blurb: Tell the mosquitoes to buzz off, naturally. Citronella, lemongrass, and five other essential oils in a 2 oz amber spray, no DEET, no sticky residue, just Southern summer survival.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Citronella, Lemongrass, Peppermint, Tea Tree, Lavender, Rosemary)

usageGuide.howToApply: Shake vigorously before each use. Mist evenly across exposed skin and outer clothing before heading outdoors. Reapply every 2 hours as needed.
usageGuide.storage: Store in a cool spot out of direct car heat and direct sun. Shelf life is 12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: DEET-free: essential oils in an alcohol base with a preservative to keep it shelf-stable. Spray a small test patch on forearm 24 hours before first full outdoor use.
